name: Rank from both ends
derivation: A person who is $L$-th from the left has $L-1$ people on the left.
Being $R$-th from the right leaves $R-1$ people on the right.
With both positions counted from the same end, the people strictly between are $|p_A - p_B| - 1$.
A rank from the other end converts by $p = \text{Total} - R + 1$.
common_traps: Adding $L + R$ and forgetting to subtract the person counted twice (gives one too many).
Subtracting a left rank from a right rank without converting to the same end.
Answering $|p_A - p_B|$ for the number between (one too many).
In 'top/bottom' rank questions, treating rank 1 as the bottom.

verification.code:
import random

random.seed(0)
n = 0
for _ in range(2000):
    total = random.randint(2, 200)
    row = list(range(total))
    random.shuffle(row)
    a, b = random.sample(row, 2)
    pa, pb = row.index(a), row.index(b)
    left_a, right_a = pa + 1, total - pa
    assert left_a + right_a - 1 == total                  # total from both-end ranks of one person
    between = len(row[min(pa, pb) + 1:max(pa, pb)])
    assert between == abs(pa - pb) - 1                    # persons between two ranks from the same end
    # B's rank from the right converted to the left before subtracting
    left_b = total - (total - pb) + 1
    assert abs(left_a - left_b) - 1 == between
    n += 1
# Constructed: A is 12th from left and 9th from right -> 20 in the row
assert 12 + 9 - 1 == 20
print(f"CASES={n}")

name: Comparison chain
statement: \text{Write all comparisons as one chain (A > B > C) and read the extreme or middle element; check every clue is used.}
derivation: Turn each sentence into '>' pieces: 'P is taller than Q but shorter than R' = R > P > Q.
Join pieces that share a person into one chain.
Insert the remaining clues: S < Q extends the right end, T > R the left end.
Read the answer only if its place is fixed; if two persons can swap, that position is not determined.
common_traps: Reading 'shorter than' in the same direction as 'taller than'.
Answering a position that two orderings disagree on as if it were fixed.
Dropping a 'but' clause (P shorter than R) and losing one link of the chain.
